关于我的一些事(Something about Me): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
My friend Tom is very kind.
I often play volleyball after class.
Ben and Tom are in the same class.
In fact, she bought some fruit at the market.
column3: 她在市场买了一些水果。
